definitions.completed: Cases with a verdict (analysisStatus COMPLETE). Only these enter the score denominator.
definitions.incomplete: Cases with verdict null (analysisStatus INCOMPLETE). Never counted as STABLE, never in the score denominator; they lower coverage (completed/expected) and force analysisStatus INCOMPLETE.
definitions.coverage: 100 × completed / expected, shown alongside every score so a high score cannot hide low coverage.
definitions.scoreMeaning: The score is a proportion over the synthetic mutation set, NOT a production failure probability.
definitions.stableFalseAlarm: Stable control: mismatches / pairs, where a mismatch is a case whose actual verdict differs from the golden expected verdict (PROJECT_BOOK §12.2). An incomplete case counts as a mismatch.
definitions.fragileDetection: Fragile control: matched / pairs, where matched means the actual verdict equals the golden expected verdict (S0 gate definition: detected = pairs − mismatches). This is agreement with golden, NOT a count of planted failures; the planted-failure subset (expected verdict != STABLE) is reported separately as plantedDetected / plantedExpected.

incompleteWorkedExample.description: Synthetic 8-case set computed by the score module: 5 STABLE, 1 WRONG_TARGET, 1 MISSING, 1 INCOMPLETE.
incompleteWorkedExample.wrongDenominatorCheck: If the incomplete case wrongly entered the denominator, the score would be 100 × 5 / 8 = 62.5; the module gives 100 × 5 / 7 = 71.429.

limitations: All 192 frozen cases are COMPLETE, so the live run contains no genuine incomplete case; incomplete handling is evidenced by the synthetic worked example above plus the live ERROR probe in this test file (invalid CSS yields verdict null / INCOMPLETE and is excluded from the score denominator).
Fragile detectionRate follows the S0 gate definition (agreement with golden, 96/96); the planted-failure subset is 45/45 and is reported separately under plantedDetectionFraction.
Scores are proportions over the synthetic 24×8 mutation set, not production failure probabilities.
